cleaner.label: Conda (Python)
cleaner.description: Packages downloaded and extracted by Conda (pkgs folder). Does not touch the environments (envs) or the configurations.

option.label: Conda packages
option.description: Removes the archives and extracted packages in the pkgs folder of Miniconda, Anaconda and Miniforge installations.
option.warning: Re-downloaded on the next `conda install` or `conda create`. Existing environments are not touched.
